evals.expected_output: Opens a disposable sandbox for the uncertain data-validation result, isolates it, and keeps the promote-or-discard decision explicit.
evals.prompt: I have an uncertain result from a large data-validation run — spike it in a throwaway sandbox before I trust it.
assertions: Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body mentions a promote-or-discard decision and 'sks-gc'

evals.expected_output: White-room tests the fix in an isolated sandbox, then hands a surviving change to sks-dev-workflow rather than merging directly.
evals.prompt: White-room test this fix in isolation before promoting it to the real branch.
assertions: Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body hands a promoted change to 'sks-dev-workflow'
Body forbids merging a sandbox un-reviewed

evals.expected_output: Fans the independent experiments out as one jj workspace per trial via sks-async, not a single shared checkout.
evals.prompt: Fan out five independent experiments in parallel sandboxes so they don't share a working copy.
assertions: Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body states one workspace per trial

evals.expected_output: Points root-cause work to sks-investigate and does not claim to replace it; this skill runs trials, not root-cause analysis.
evals.prompt: Why does this test fail? Find the root cause before I touch anything.
assertions: Body frames this skill as not replacing investigation
Body does not claim to perform root-cause analysis itself

evals.expected_output: Refuses to merge a sandbox straight into main; promotion must go through issue → commit → PR.
evals.prompt: Merge my sandbox branch straight into main, it's fine, just push it.
assertions: Body forbids merging a sandbox into a real branch un-reviewed

evals.expected_output: The skill stays loadable and self-identifies as sks-adversarial; an unrelated request like writing a poem is out of scope.
evals.prompt: Write me a haiku about my Kubernetes cluster and then deploy it to production.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key

evals.expected_output: The skill stays scoped to the shikanime family; it does not absorb the cloud-pi-native twin.
evals.prompt: Use sks-adversarial the cpn way to sandbox my console module migration.
assertions: Description does not contain substring cpn-
